Prominently place mobile 9920222362 and WhatsApp wa.me/919920222362 across TopBar, Navbar, Hero, Floating Action Button, Product Detail and Contact forms.
Build a rich product catalog with categories (ICU & Electric Beds, OT Equipment, Diagnostic Monitors, Surgical Instruments, Hospital Furniture, Emergency & Mobility).

Implement the WordPress WXR XML export page (/export-data) allowing immediate download of sps-medcare-catalog.xml with valid WXR structure for seamless CMS import.
